text_block_list.name: Talk Show Host
text_block_list.text:
And now, let's welcome them! Live on 
"Afternoon Talks," today's special guest 
is—

text_block_list.name: Talk Show Host
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, the most talked-about, 
super-duper popular Umamusume! It's 
Epiphaneia-saaaan!!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Hello!!!!
choice_data_list:
It's clipping, so tone it down a 
little...!

text_block_list.name: Talk Show Host
text_block_list.text:
Incredible support! And so, we also have 
Epiphaneia's Trainer joining us today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since Epiphaneia was going to appear on a 
"live broadcast," I came along just in 
case something happened. I was supposed to 
just watch from the shadows... or so I 
thought.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
My Trainer's gotta come along too, of 
course! —Yeah! Even the 'Voice of Destiny' 
says so!
choice_data_list: (Put that way... I can hardly refuse.)

text_block_list.name: Talk Show Host
text_block_list.text:
Now then! Epiphaneia-san is currently the 
hottest Umamusume in the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Talk Show Host
text_block_list.text:
There's no end to the list of 
accomplishments, but— first is achieving 
the Spring Senior Triple Crown by winning 
the Osaka Hai, Tenno Sho (Spring), and 
Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Talk Show Host
text_block_list.text:
What's・more! By winning the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn), Japan Cup, and Arima Kinen, you 
will achieve the Autumn Senior Triple 
Crown!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"A super, super, super great feat that 
nobody in history has ever accomplished!!"

text_block_list.name: Talk Show Host
text_block_list.text:
And for the wonderful Epiphaneia, we've 
received so many flowers celebrating her 
appearance on the show~!

text_block_list.name: Talk Show Host
text_block_list.text:
One from Cesario-san, too... wait, huh? 
"Congratulations, from Epiphaneia"? Wait, 
why from herself...?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It's for you, Trainer! Because I always 
believed we'd run together!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Congrats on your TV appearance, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Talk Show Host
text_block_list.text:
All right, now that we've had that 
heartwarming exchange! We have a message 
from that very person♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"—To all the viewers watching the program. 
I am... Symboli Kris S."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
And now... Epi. You have—erected a 
monumental milestone.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Keep running at that pace... —For the sake 
of the "future."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, of course!! I'm going to create the 
future!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —How dependable.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Kris S?! Whoa, you scared me!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Surprise.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Once again... congratulations. And—thanks.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Watching you run reignites the fire in 
everyone. The racing world will progress 
even further.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...So that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You really do look at the bigger picture! 
Just what I'd expect from my master.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it's way too early to thank me! 
I'm going to make my name roar far, far 
wider!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"The voice of destiny says so too! So keep 
watching over me till the end!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Of course.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Symboli Kris S's surprise appearance, 
the broadcast was a huge hit. And so, 
Epiphaneia's appearance concluded without 
a hitch.
choice_data_list:
(Thank goodness things didn't get out of 
hand...)

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: Good work, Epi.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Eff! Were you watching the whole time!?

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I heard Epi-san's great achievements 
would be showcased... so I wanted to see 
it for myself.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
I found it quite fascinating to observe. 
...And it brought back memories.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
That tremendous run by Epi-san that I 
witnessed at the Arima Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
Following in Epi-san's great footsteps, I 
will achieve results worthy of our 
household as well.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Yeah! You can do it! Give it your all!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...F. You came?

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: ...Hello.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, my two favorite people are 
together! I'm so happy, I wanna do 
something together!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oh, let's go get lunch right now! 
Gathering around a round table for Chinese 
sounds great!! The voice of destiny says 
so too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Shark fin! Dried abalone! Sea cucumber!! 
We'll eat all the delicious food, talk a 
ton, and be even happier!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Caught between the senior whose back she 
chased, and the junior who now chases 
hers... Epiphaneia smiled happily between 
them.
